candidates.name: Brain Abscess
support_spans: Noncontrast head CT demonstrated a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage

Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema, scattered small foci of restricted diffusion, and subtle punctate blooming on susceptibility-weighted images; there was no enhancement after gadolinium
Repeat MRI demonstrated progression with new involvement of the left basal ganglia, increased diffusion restriction, development of necrosis, and new peripheral contrast enhancement
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with altered mental status, fever, and focal neurological deficits, combined with imaging findings of a hypodense area with mass effect and progression on repeat MRI, is consistent with a brain abscess.
